scripts.predev: pkill -9 -f "[n]ext-server" || true; pkill -9 -f "[n]ext dev" || true; npx -y kill-port 3000 8000 || true
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "./backend/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2560' npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.prestart: pkill -9 -f "[n]ext-server" || true; pkill -9 -f "[n]ext dev" || true; npx -y kill-port 3000 8000 || true
scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "./backend/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
